name: Storyteller's Mask
text: Your mask remembers the stories of Shifting Frog, Storyteller of the Past and Future. You can cast Foresight once per day as an innate spell, either arcane if you have Wizard Dedication or primal if you have Druid Dedication, but the duration is 10 minutes instead of 1 hour. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets only a single foe, you can Recall Knowledge about that foe.
